title: Research the next useful unlock
applies_when: Immediate survival work is covered and some labor can research.
approach: Start with one usable research bench and an enabled researcher. Select a project; building extra benches does not help one researcher.
Choose an unlock that fixes the next constraint: storage for intermittent power, clothing for cold, or stonecutting for durable construction when not already unlocked.
Check starting technology and prerequisites before proposing research. Crashlanded and tribal colonies do not start with the same unlocks.
Name what will be built or changed after the research, including its resource needs. Avoid researching a long chain with no near-term use while basics stall.
verify: Active project, compatible bench, researcher availability and progress.
reconsider: A different shortage is now urgent or the unlocked equipment cannot be supplied.
